candidate.title: TRAP-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina TRAP-Seq schematic: one unbranched route from capped polysomal RNA through bead affinity capture and RNA isolation to reverse transcription and cDNA. Visible labels are RNA and Targeted purification of polysomal mRNA (TRAP-Seq) in the far-left method key, then Cap, Polysomes, Bead, RNA, Reverse transcription and cDNA in the main route. The left method key shows yellow-highlighted ribosome-associated RNA and has no arrow into the main route; it is descriptive, not an independent processed branch. The blue line above Reverse transcription belongs to that conversion stage, not a separately named intermediate. TRAP (translating ribosome affinity purification) is the capture component of the single TRAP-Seq target. Tagged-protein expression is a reported starting prerequisite. The drawing terminates at cDNA; downstream sequencing explains the readout, without adding unshown library-preparation operations. The drawing names no species, tag or kit; primary-source implementations clarify the depicted principle without fixing every implementation detail.

states.label: Capped mRNA associated with polysomes
features: Purple RNA bears two blue ribosome symbols (Polysomes); the black square at its left end is explicitly labeled Cap.

Source-reported starting prerequisite: tagged ribosomal protein is expressed and incorporated into the ribosomes to be selected. Cell-type attribution depends on the expression domain of that tagged protein.
This is the depicted polysome substrate; the cited TRAP protocol abstract defines the broader target as mRNA associated with at least one 80S ribosome.

operations.label: Targeted purification of polysomal mRNA (TRAP-Seq): bead capture
operations.description: Capture the tagged ribosomes together with their associated RNA on the depicted bead. The input polysomes become bead-associated complexes; the RNA remains ribosome-associated at this boundary.
operations.mechanism: The tagged ribosomal protein provides an affinity handle recognized by bead-associated antibody, interpreting the pink Y-shaped attachments. The bead is a capture support. In the cited Jiao/Meyerowitz implementation, HF–RPL18 carries N-terminal His/FLAG tags and anti-FLAG affinity material captures the complexes; those identities are paper-specific clarifications, not labels in the drawing.
operations.information_effect: Selects RNA by co-purification with targeted ribosomes. Where tag expression is cell-type restricted, that expression domain provides the population-level cellular association. The physical carrier is the tagged ribosome–RNA complex; ribosome co-precipitation alone does not prove translation of every recovered RNA.
